_about: Gridfinity Rugged Case - parametric spec shared by the Fusion port and the browser generator. Derived 2026-10-23 from the Onshape reference (see case_spec.md). All lengths mm. Expressions use the variables below and + - * / ( ) only.

x_count.doc: grid units along X (length); max 8 = 344.5 mm outside (Prusa XL bed)

y_count.doc: grid units along Y (width, latch side = -Y); max 8 = 358.5 mm outside

z_count.doc: Gridfinity height units of the inner space (7 mm each)

window_gap.doc: extra pocket depth above the plexiglass (print side) so the printer can bridge over it after the pause; 0 = Onshape original

print_layout.doc: arrange parts in print orientation instead of assembled

frame: Origin = XY centre of the cavity, z = 0 = floor top (bin seating plane). Front (latches) = -Y, back (hinges) = +Y. Wall profiles use s = distance outward from the inner wall (cavity outline 42*x_count x 42*y_count, corner r 4); the perimeter path for a profile point at s has corner radius 4 + s.

profiles._note: Closed polygons in (s, z). 'r' = fillet radius at that vertex. Built by sweeping along the perimeter offset path.

lid_wall_front_override._note: Front (-Y) wall only: replace the last vertex (0, split) by these two -> 0.5 x 2 lead-in so the lid clears the base while closing.

cells._note: Per Gridfinity cell (42 x 42, outline corner r 4). t = distance inward from the cell outline. Internal boundaries get both neighbours' halves.

foot_pad._note: underside: 45 deg taper from a 35.6 sq r 0.8 pad at z=-3.2 up to z=+0.3 (42.6 sq r 4.3, i.e. 0.3 beyond the cell outline). Everything else of the base ends at the underside plane z=0.3, so the V-notches between pads run out through the wall and leave a small star-shaped void under every grid crossing. Pockets are cut after the pads are joined.

lid_frame_opening._note: under the window: through opening 35.7 sq r 0.85, from z = top-5.5 to the window seat

lid_frame_groove._note: 45 deg chamfer cut on the frame underside: 40.3 sq r 3.15 at z = top-4 widening downwards to 37.3 sq at top-5.5 (rib profile below). Built as per-cell skirts (37.3 r 1.65 at top-5.5 growing 45 deg to 40.3 r 3.15 at top-4) so the grooves run out into the wall; the lid wall sweep stops at top-4.

lid_top_opening._note: above the window: concentric offset of the cell outline, 3.009 at z = top-1.2 (35.982 sq r 0.991) widening at 45 deg to 1.809 at the lid top (38.382 sq r 2.191); Onshape sketch said 37.2 r1.6 at top-0.6, measured 37.182

pocket._note: seat = top - 1.2 - wt - gap: the window rests against the top ribs (bed side when printing upside down); the gap is on the frame side, pause at 1.2 + wt + gap above the bed

end_ribs._note: on both X end walls, full height at s = 4.26, own 45 deg end chamfers (see case_spec.md)

hardware._note: Size-independent modules, mirrored to x = +hinge_x and -hinge_x. Exact outlines: ../onshape/hardware_sections.txt (5x4x6: hinge_x 78, Wi/2 84, split 36).
hardware.screw: M3 x 30 (6 per case: 2 hinge pins, 2 latch pivots, 2 latch catches)

hinge_back.gusset: 45 deg from the outer wall (s 2.4) at split -/+ 10.268 to the knuckle tangent
hinge_back.holes: lid knuckle 3.4; base knuckle towards the case centre 2.85 (tap); base knuckle at the case end 3.4 (screw head outside)

latch_front.holes: rib towards the case end 3.4, rib towards the centre 2.85 (tap), at both axes

latch_part.profile_source: Rugged Box Sketch 10 (src_rugged_box_sketches.txt), mapped y_case = y_src - (Wi/2 - 35), z_case = z_src + split - 30
